title: Dream to Assist: Intent-Conditioned World Models for Shared Vehicle Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.34650v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Assistive agents in shared-control settings face a dual challenge: acting proactively to align with the human's intentions while remaining legible enough for the human to comprehend and fluently respond in real time. We present Dream2Assist, a model-based reinforcement learning framework for tightly-coupled shared decision making that addresses both sides of this challenge. Our approach extends a recurrent state-space world model with intent inference, enabling an assistive policy trained via fictitious co-play to anticipate and support discrete human objectives without overriding human agency. Beyond the computational framework, we describe the full deployment pipeline needed to translate a world-model-based policy into a safe, human-centered system in a resource-efficient way. translated_title: 梦想以辅助：面向共享车辆控制的意图条件世界模型
translated_abstract: 共享控制环境下的辅助智能体面临双重挑战：既要主动行动以对齐人类的意图，又要保持足够的行为可读性，使人类能够理解并实时流畅地做出响应。我们提出了Dream2Assist，一个用于紧密耦合共享决策的基于模型的强化学习框架，同时应对了这一挑战的两个方面。我们的方法在循环状态空间世界模型中引入了意图推断，使得通过虚构协同对局训练的辅助策略能够预测并支持人类的离散目标，而不会凌驾于人类的自主权之上。除了计算框架之外，我们还描述了以资源高效的方式将基于世界模型的策略转化为安全、以人为中心的系统所需的完整部署流程。至关重要的是，我们在迭代式人机界面设计中通过策略筛选和奖励重构来解决仿真到真实人类的迁移差距。
tldr: 提出了Dream2Assist框架，通过在循环状态空间世界模型中引入意图推断并结合虚构协同对局训练，使共享车辆控制中的辅助智能体能够预测人类意图、主动且可读地提供辅助，同时通过完整部署流程和奖励重构解决了仿真到真实人类的迁移差距。
en_tdlr: Dream2Assist introduces an intent-conditioned recurrent state-space world model trained via fictitious co-play, enabling assistive agents in shared vehicle control to anticipate human intentions while remaining legible, and bridges the sim-to-real-human gap through a full deployment pipeline with policy down-selection and reward restructuring.
